propositions: Implement read-only derivations over the durable event store to compute five agent-process metrics (attempts-per-ticket, first-pass-verification-rate, rework-at-7/30-days, reopen-recovery, revert-linked-recovery) using a hybrid data-access model: raw event files for per-event/multi-occurrence metrics and compiled state for terminal-value metrics.

Metrics requiring per-event data (attempts_per_ticket, rework_within_days, reopen_recovery) must read raw event files sorted via event_sort_key and filtered by is_active_event to include compaction-retired events, while metrics needing only terminal state (first_pass_rate, revert_recovery) read compiled reduce_ticket output.

The event-derivation reader must distinguish between compiled state (single terminal value e.g. last_reopened_at, reverts[]) and raw events (ordered sequence of STATUS transitions e.g. open→in_progress, closed→open), reusing existing reducer helpers rather than reinventing file handling.
Metrics over empty ranges return None to signal Unavailable in the registry; metrics over populated ranges with zero qualifying events return measured 0 (distinct from unavailable).

The implementation must filter STATUS edges correctly (open→in_progress for attempts, closed→open for rework/reopen), track distinct sessions via data.session, and validate revert target_event_type to distinguish substantive reverts (STATUS/COMMITS) from metadata reverts (COMMENT/LINK).
